title: BM25 Corpus IDF + CJK Bigrams + 3x Field Weighting for Recall
trigger: Recall@1 dropped to 40% when high-fitness distractor genes contained common stop-words
strategy: Implement Robertson-Sparck Jones IDF, CJK bigrams, stop-word filtering, and 3x trigger/title field weighting

title: Self-Healing DAG Node Retry with Critical Path Scorecard
trigger: Any code modification, bug fix, or refactoring task
strategy: On DAG node failure, extract FailureDiagnosis, inject recalled recovery genes into EVLOP_RECOVERY_GENES_JSON, auto-retry up to max_retries, and compute critical_path_nodes
anti_pattern: Self-reporting success based solely on reading the code diff

title: Subagent Context Isolation for Deep Exploration
trigger: Exploring unfamiliar modules, tracing cross-repo references, or reading >5 files
strategy: Dispatch an Explore/research subagent and only ingest its structured summary into the main loop
anti_pattern: Dumping thousands of lines of raw file contents into the primary conversation context

title: Explicit UTF-8 Encoding on Cross-Platform File I/O
trigger: Reading/writing files or capturing subprocess stdout/stderr across Windows/Linux
strategy: Always specify encoding='utf-8' in Path.read_text, Path.write_text, open(), and subprocess.run()
anti_pattern: Calling Path.read_text() or subprocess.run(text=True) without explicit encoding

title: Latency-Profiled Execution Verification Gate
trigger: Any code modification, bug fix, or refactoring task
strategy: Run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v via evlop verify to capture exit_code==0 and duration_ms
anti_pattern: Self-reporting success based solely on reading the code diff

title: Execution-Verified Patching Gate
trigger: Any code modification, bug fix, or refactoring task
strategy: Run python -m evlop verify '<test-cmd>' and confirm exit_code == 0 before concluding
anti_pattern: Self-reporting success based solely on reading the code diff
